Hi Alice — thanks for the constraints; that makes scheduling much easier. A few technical notes ahead of the demo (attached: network-diagram.png):

- Demo can run entirely against a sandbox region — no production keys required. We recommend a short-lived allowlist for our demo host (IP: 35.209.77.12) or a VPN peering tunnel if you prefer.
- During the demo we’ll show API traffic patterns and KV cache behavior; please let us know if packet captures or deeper network logs are needed so we can keep sensitive data out of the demo feed.
- Required ports: 443 outbound, occasional ephemeral ports for WebSocket streaming. If you use strict egress rules, add the demo host IP and hostname as an allowlist 24 hours prior.

Two confirmed windows that match your preference:
- Tue 23 Mar 09:30–10:30 JST (preferred)
- Wed 24 Mar 09:00–10:00 JST (fallback)
